steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Ballet is characterised by turnout, pointe work, elevation and precise classical technique

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Contemporary dance blends ballet and modern techniques with an emphasis on floor work and weight

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Jazz dance combines African rhythms, theatrical performance and syncopated, energetic movement

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Hip-hop dance includes breaking, locking, popping and krumping, rooted in urban street culture

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Always name the specific style and describe its technical features when analysing a professional work Use style-specific vocabulary such as 'turnout', 'release', 'syncopation' rather than generic terms When comparing styles, discuss at least two contrasting features such as posture, dynamics or use of space Link style features directly to the choreographer's intention — do not just list characteristics Remember that many professional works blend styles; be precise about which elements come from which tradition
